description: Original renderer close acknowledgement relay with its existing Electron/EventEmitter mocks; no real window, app or tab is touched.
isolationRationale: Coordinator read the complete3-file runtime closure. Original test vi.mock('electron') provides ipcMain functions over an EventEmitter. BrowserWindow/webContents are test EventEmitter objects. Module uses randomUUID, timeout and listener functions only. Real short-lived timers are cleared on settlement; the5min lease test uses original fake timers. No Electron process, user window/tab, filesystem, network or provider action is executed. Do not change the mocks or assertions. This is not a security sandbox.
runtimeImports: electron replaced by original inline mock factory
relative source session-tab-close contract and dynamic import of relay
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Both configs use node. Execute with Node24.19.0 and original installed Vitest4.1.11; no package install.
Minimal config omits feature-wall define, renderer aliases and DOM/host-port setup, unused by this closure.

Root GC/webstorage flags, Windows worker override and30s/60s per-test/hook limits are omitted. Test-owned fake timers drive lease expiry; default unit timeouts and30s outer bound remain. No platform or full-config equivalence claim.
testEvidenceBoundary: Four direct tests plus3 literal table rows. Only wrong sender is exercised in acknowledgement test, not wrong requestId; source has both guards. Missing/destroyed-window preflight, send throw, multiple concurrent requests and real renderer IPC are not covered by this7-case file.
